24700.meaning1: (gram) should be employed; should be used; should be adopted

examples.text: sabbesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ paṭhamamajjhim'uttamapurisānaṃ ek'ābhidhāne paro puriso gahetabbo. so ca paṭhati, tvañ'ca paṭhasi, tumhe paṭhatha. so ca pacati, tvañ'ca pacasi. tumhe pacatha. evaṃ sesāsu vibhattīsu paro puriso yojetabbo.
sace thero gaṇhāti, therassa patto dutiyassa gāhetabbo. na ca tassa anuddayatāya na gahetabbo. yo na gaṇheyya, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

24702.meaning1: should be held; must be clutched

24703.meaning2: who takes hold of; who grasps; who mentions

examples.text: asīti me, āvuso, vassāni pabbajitassa n'ābhijānāmi mātugāmassa anubyañjanaso nimittaṃ gahetā

24704.commentary: (SNa) n'āsakkhi pañhassa pariyantaṃ gahetun'ti pañhassa paricchedaṃ pamāṇaṃ gahetuṃ n'āsakkhi, appaṭisaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ sappaṭisaraṇan'ti pucchi. nibbānaṃ nām'etaṃ appaṭisaraṇaṃ, na kiñci paṭisarati.

examples.text: accayāsi, brāhmaṇa, pañhaṃ, n'āsakkhi pañhassa pariyantaṃ gahetuṃ. nibbān'ogadhañ'hi, brāhmaṇa, brahmacariyaṃ vussati nibbānaparāyaṇaṃ nibbānapariyosānan'ti.

imehi ca pana, bhikkhave, catūhi puññ'ābhisandehi kusal'ābhisandehi samannāgatassa ariyasāvakassa na sukaraṃ puññassa pamāṇaṃ gahetuṃ, ettako puññ'ābhisando kusal'ābhisando sukhass'āhāro sovaggiko sukhavipāko saggasaṃvattaniko iṭṭhāya kantāya manāpāya hitāya sukhāya saṃvattatī'ti.

24705.meaning1: to hold; to grab; to take

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ gomayapiṇḍaṃ pāṇinā gahetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca. ettako'pi kho, bhikkhu, attabhāvapaṭilābho n'atthi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassati.

24708.meaning1: having taken control (of); having seized power

examples.text: kosalarājā mahantena balen'āgantvā bārāṇasiṃ gahetvā taṃ rājānaṃ māretvā tassa aggamah'esiṃ attano aggamah'esiṃ akāsi
bhante, imaṃ catumāsaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ gahetvā idh'eva vasatha, pāsādam'ahaṃ karissāmī'ti
so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāretvā, balaṃ gahetvā, vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu gāmā vā araññā vā adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyeyya, yathārūpe adinn'ādāne rājāno coraṃ gahetvā haneyyuṃ vā bandheyyuṃ vā pabbājeyyuṃ vā
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso chappāṇake gahetvā nānāvisaye nānāgocare daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya.
vanacārī pure āsiṃ, satataṃ vanakammiko, patth'odanaṃ gahetvāna, kamm'antaṃ agamās'ahaṃ.

evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, sace tumhe'pi… na manussaggāho gahessati, na amanussaggāho gahessati, na āvaṭṭaggāho gahessati, na antopūtī bhavissatha, evaṃ tumhe, bhikkhave, nibbānaninnā bhavissatha nibbānapoṇā nibbānapabbhārā.
yaṃ pubbe taṃ visosehi, pacchā te m'āhu kiñcanaṃ, majjhe ce no gahessasi, upasanto carissasi.

24717.commentary: (SNa) gaḷagaḷāyante'ti gajjante. (THa) devo ca vassati, devo ca gaḷagaḷāyatī'ti devo megho vassati ca, gaḷagaḷā'ti ca karonto gajjatī'ti attho. gajjantassa hi anukaraṇam'etaṃ.

24718.grammar: pr, onom, deno of gaḷagala, intrans
24718.meaning1: roars; clamours; thunders; makes a loud noise
24718.meaning2: rains heavily making the sound gala-gala, roars
24718.commentary: (THa) devo ca vassati, devo ca gaḷagaḷāyatī'ti devo megho vassati ca, gaḷagaḷā'ti ca karonto gajjatī'ti attho. gajjantassa hi anukaraṇam'etaṃ.

examples.text: devo ca vassati devo ca gaḷagaḷāyati, ekako c'āhaṃ bherave bile viharāmi, tassa mayhaṃ ekakassa bherave bile viharato, n'atthi bhayaṃ vā chambhitattaṃ vā lomahaṃso vā.

24719.grammar: prp of gaḷagaḷāyati, onom, deno, intrans
24719.meaning1: roaring; clamouring; thundering; making a loud noise

examples.text: idāni, bhante, deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balibaddā
seyyathā'pi nāma deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatā niccharanti, evam'assa mukhato jivhā niccharati. seyyathā'pi nāma kammāragaggariyā dhamamānāya saddo hoti, evam'assa assāsapassāsānaṃ saddo hoti.
anelagalāyā'ti elagaḷenavirahitāya. yassa kassaci hi kathentassa elā gaḷanti, lālā vā paggharanti, kheḷaphusitāni vā nikkhamanti, tassa vācā elagaḷaṃ nāma hoti, tabbiparitāyā'ti attho.
atha kho āyasmā aṅgulimālo bhinnena sīsena, lohitena gaḷantena, bhinnena pattena, vipphālitāya saṅghāṭiyā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami
atha kho, pāpima, āyasmā vidhuro bhinnena sīsena lohitena gaḷantena kakusandhaṃ'y'eva bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi.

24725.meaning1: spoke this verse; uttered this stanza

examples.text: evaṃ dasasu lokadhātusahassesu devakāye niddisitvā idāni yadatthaṃ te āgatā, taṃ dassento pavuṭṭhajātinti gātham'āha.
tato te'pi māṇavakā pabbajj'āpekkhā hutvā evañ'ce ruccati, bhototi gātham'āhaṃsu. atha selo tesu māṇavakesu tuṭṭhacitto te ca dassento pabbajjaṃ yācanto brāhmaṇā'ti gātham'āha.
sahassam'api ce gāthā, anatthapadasaṃhitā, ekaṃ gāthāpadaṃ seyyo, yaṃ sutvā upasammati.
atha kho kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi.

24727.meaning1: suttas comprised of verse; one of the nine kinds of suttas
24727.commentary: (MNa) dhammapadaṃ, theragāthā, therigāthā, suttanipāte nosuttanāmikā suddhikagāthā ca gāthā'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacce moghapurisā dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti, suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.

24729.meaning1: and this verse; and this poem

examples.text: idh'āgamā vijjupabhāsavaṇṇā, kokanadā pajjunnassa dhītā, buddhañ'ca dhammañ'ca namassamānā, gāthā'c'imā atthavatī abhāsi.

24730.meaning1: home of verses; abode of poetry; (comm) support for poetry
24730.commentary: (SNa) āsayo'ti patiṭṭhā. kavito hi gāthā pavattanti. so tāsaṃ patiṭṭhā hotī'ti.

examples.text: kiṃsu nidānaṃ gāthānaṃ, kiṃsu tāsaṃ viyañjanaṃ, kiṃsu sannissitā gāthā, kiṃsu gāthānam'āsayo'ti.
chando nidānaṃ gāthānaṃ, akkharā tāsaṃ viyañjanaṃ, nāmasannissitā gāthā, kavi gāthānam'āsayo'ti.

24731.commentary: (DHPa) ekaṃ gāthāpadaṃ seyyo'ti appamādo amatapadaṃ… yathā mayā'ti (dha. pa. 21) evarūpā ekā gāthā'pi seyyo'ti attho.

examples.text: sahassam'api ce gāthā, anatthapadasaṃhitā, ekaṃ gāthāpadaṃ seyyo, yaṃ sutvā upasammati.

24733.meaning1: chanted over with verses; recited over

examples.text: gāth'ābhigītaṃ me abhojaneyyaṃ, sampassataṃ brāhmaṇa n'esa dhammo, gāth'ābhigītaṃ panudanti buddhā, dhamme satī brāhmaṇa vutti'r'esā.
sattadhā me phale muddhā, jīvanto na sukhaṃ labhe, buddhagāth'ābhigīto'mhi, no ce muñceyya candiman'ti.

24734.meaning1: addressed in verse; spoke this poem

examples.text: atha kho kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi.

24735.meaning1: foothold; footing; ground for standing on (in)

examples.text: n'atthi kiccaṃ brāhmaṇassa, katakicco hi brāhmaṇo, yāva na gādhaṃ labhati nadīsu, āyūhati sabbagattebhi jantu, gādhañ'ca laddhāna thale ṭhito yo, n'āyūhatī pāragato hi so'va.

24737.meaning1: finds a footing; stands firmly; is well grounded; finds a support
24737.meaning2: stands fast, has a firm footing

examples.text: kattha āpo ca pathavī, tejo vāyo na gādhati, kattha dīghañ'ca rassañ'ca, aṇuṃ thūlaṃ subh'āsubhaṃ, kattha nāmañ'ca rūpañ'ca, asesaṃ uparujjhatī'ti.
ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipannā, te suppaṭipannā. ye suppaṭipannā, te imasmiṃ dhammavinaye gādhanti.

24738.meaning1: gets a foothold; finds a footing
24738.commentary: (SNa) gādham'edhatī'ti udakaṃ otaraṇakāle gambhīre udake patiṭṭhaṃ labhati.

examples.text: andhakāre pure hoti, gambhīre gādham'edhati, daṇḍassa ānubhāvena, khalitvā patitiṭṭhatī'ti.

24739.meaning1: seeks a foothold; looks for a footing (in)
24739.commentary: (SNa) selaṃ'va siras'ūhacca, pātāle gādham'esathā'ti mahantaṃ kūṭ'āgārappamāṇaṃ silaṃ sīse ṭhapetvā pātāle patiṭṭhagavesanaṃ viya.

examples.text: selaṃ'va siras'ūhacca, pātāle gādham'esatha, khāṇuṃ'va uras'āsajja, nibbijj'āpetha gotamā'ti.

24740.meaning2: stood fast, had a firm footing

examples.text: yathā'pi bhamaro pupphaṃ, vaṇṇagandham'aheṭhayaṃ, paleti rasam'ādāya, evaṃ gāme munī care.
yathā brahmā tathā eko, yathā devo tathā duve, yathā gāmo tathā tayo, kolāhalaṃ tat'uttarin'ti.

24743.synonym: kāya, khandha, jāta, nikāya, bhāga, vagga

examples.text: so bījagāmabhūtagāmasamārambhā paṭivirato hoti
idha, visākhe, mātugāmo susaṃvihitakamm'anto hoti, saṅgahitaparijano, bhattu manāpaṃ carati, sambhataṃ anurakkhati.
abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī ahosiṃ ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.

24746.commentary: (MNa) beluvagāmake'ti vesāliyā dakkhiṇapasse avidūre beluvagāmako nāma atthi, taṃ gocaragāmaṃ katvā'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando vesāliyaṃ viharati beluvagāmake. tena kho pana samayena dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro pāṭaliputtaṃ anuppatto hoti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.
gāmakathaṃ nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthikathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ
cakkhūhi n'eva lol'assa, gāmakathāya āvaraye sotaṃ, rase ca n'ānugijjheyya, na ca mamāyetha kiñci lokasmiṃ.

24750.meaning1: village monastery; house in a village
24750.commentary: (PYt) gāmak'āvāsan'ti gāmo'y'eva khuddak'aṭṭhena gāmako, tasmiṃ kārito āvāso gāmak'āvāso, taṃ.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhuniyo gāmak'āvāse vassaṃvuṭṭhā sāvatthiṃ agamaṃsu vattasampannā iriyāpathasampannā duccoḷā lūkhacīvarā.

24751.meaning2: village magistrate; village chief (with a connotation of dishonesty?)

24752.meaning1: corrupt village magistrate; crooked judge; (or) village headman
24752.commentary: (SNa) gāmakūṭako'ti vinicchay'āmacco. (SNt) vinicchay'āmacco'ti raññā aḍḍakaraṇe ṭhapito vinicchayamah'āmatto. so hi gāmajanakāyaṃ kūṭeti vañcetī'ti gāmakūṭako'ti vuccati. keci tādiso eva gāmajeṭṭhako gāmakūṭako'ti vadanti.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ gijjhā'pi kākā'pi kulalā'pi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitacchenti virājenti. so sudaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karoti … eso, bhikkhave, satto imasmiṃ'y'eva rājagahe gāmakūṭako ahosi

24753.commentary: (ANa) dve vā tīṇi vā māgadhakāni gāmakkhettānī'ti ettha māgadhikaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ atthi khuddakaṃ, atthi majjhimaṃ, atthi mahantaṃ. khuddakaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ ito cattālīsaṃ usabhāni, ito cattālīsan'ti gāvutaṃ hoti, majjhimaṃ ito gāvutaṃ, ito gāvutan'ti aḍḍhayojanaṃ hoti, mahantaṃ ito diyaḍḍhagāvutaṃ, ito diyaḍḍhagāvutan'ti tigāvutaṃ hoti. tesu khuddakena gāmakkhettena tīṇi, khuddakena ca majjhimena ca dve gāmakkhettāni tassa attabhāvo. tigāvutañ'hi'ssa sarīraṃ.

examples.text: ye kho te samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā amhākaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ āgacchanti, atithī no te honti. atithī kho pan'amhehi sakkātabbā garukātabbā mānetabbā pūjetabbā.

24754.commentary: (THIa) gāmakhettānī'ti gāme ca pubb'aṇṇ'āpar'aṇṇa-viruhana-kkhettāni ca, gāmapariyāpannāni vā khettāni.

examples.text: hitvān'ahaṃ ñātigaṇaṃ, dāsakammakarāni ca, gāmakhettāni phītāni, ramaṇīye pamodite.
evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, goṇo kiṭṭh'ādo gāmagato vā araññagato vā, ṭhānabahulo vā assa nisajjabahulo vā na taṃ kiṭṭhaṃ puna otareyya, tam'eva purimaṃ daṇḍasamphassaṃ samanussaranto.

evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhikkhu gāmagato vā araññagato vā labhati vattāraṃ, ayañ'ca kho āyasmā evaṃkārī evaṃsamācāro asucigāmakaṇṭako'ti. taṃ kaṇṭako'ti iti viditvā saṃvaro ca asaṃvaro ca veditabbo.
adinn'ādāyī hoti. yaṃ taṃ parassa paravitt'ūpakaraṇaṃ gāmagataṃ vā araññagataṃ vā taṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādātā hoti.

yassa kassaci, mahānāma, kulaputtassa pañca dhammā saṃvijjanti, yadi vā rañño khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa, yadi vā raṭṭhikassa pettanikassa, yadi vā senāya senāpatikassa, yadi vā gāmagāmaṇikassa, yadi vā pūgagāmaṇikassa, ye vā pana kulesu paccek'ādhipaccaṃ kārenti, vuddhi'y'eva pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.

taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu tumhehi diṭṭhaṃ vā sutaṃ vā, raṭṭhiko … pettaṇiko… senāpatiko… gāmagāmaṇiko … pūgagāmaṇiko yāva'd'atthaṃ seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharanto yāvajīvaṃ pūgagāmaṇikattaṃ kārento pūgassa vā piyo manāpo'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

24759.meaning1: plundering of villages; looting of villages
24759.meaning2: sacking or plundering of a village

24760.meaning1: village raider; village looter; village plunderer
24760.meaning2: village raider; village looter; village plunderer

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, brāhmaṇa, purohito brāhmaṇo rājānaṃ mahāvijitaṃ etadavoca, bhoto kho rañño janapado sakaṇṭako sauppīḷo, gāmaghātā'pi dissanti, nigamaghātā'pi dissanti, nagaraghātā'pi dissanti, panthaduhanā'pi dissanti.

24761.commentary: (SNa) corā gāmaghātakā'ti yadev'ettha labhissāma, taṃ gaṇhissāma vā ghātessāma vā'ti āgatā cha gāmaghātakacorā.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, idāni, ambho purisa, imaṃ suññaṃ gāmaṃ corā gāmaghātakā pavisanti. yaṃ te, ambho purisa, karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohī'ti.
gāmaṭṭhaṃ nāma bhaṇḍaṃ gāme catūhi ṭhānehi nikkhittaṃ hoti, bhūmaṭṭhaṃ, thalaṭṭhaṃ, ākāsaṭṭhaṃ, vehāsaṭṭhaṃ.
suddhaṃ dhammasamuppādaṃ, suddhaṃ saṅkhārasantatiṃ, passantassa yathābhūtaṃ, na bhayaṃ hoti gāmaṇi.
tena kho pana samayena maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti. atha kho maṇicūḷako gāmaṇi taṃ parisaṃ etadavoca, mā ayyā evaṃ avacuttha.
dupposaṃ katvā attānaṃ, gāme gāmaṇikā viya, bhutvā bhutvā nipajjanti, par'āgāresu mucchitā.

na kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajataṃ, na sādiyanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, na paṭiggaṇhanti samaṇā sakyaputtiyā jātarūparajataṃ, nikkhittamaṇisuvaṇṇā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā apetajātarūparajatā'ti. asakkhi kho, āvuso, maṇicūḷako gāmaṇī taṃ parisaṃ saññāpetuṃ.

24772.meaning1: cow in a pit (walking in circles); pitbull; (comm) village boy

examples.text: catubbipallāsavasaṃ adhiṭṭhitaṃ, gāmaṇḍalaṃ'va parinesi citta maṃ, nanu saṃyojanabandhanacchidaṃ, saṃsevase kāruṇikaṃ mahāmuniṃ.

24773.notes: circles of boys from the village?

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, susāne seyyaṃ kappemi chav'aṭṭhikāni upadhāya. apissu maṃ, sāriputta, gāmaṇḍalā upasaṅkamitvā oṭṭhubhanti'pi, omuttenti'pi, paṃsukena'pi okiranti, kaṇṇasotesu'pi salākaṃ pavesenti.

atha kho, assalāyana, sattannaṃ brāhmaṇ'isīnaṃ etadahosi, ko n'āyaṃ gāmaṇḍalarūpo viya sattannaṃ brāhmaṇ'isīnaṃ patthaṇḍile caṅkamamāno evam'āha, handa, ko nu kho ime bhavanto brāhmaṇ'isayo gatā, handa, ko nu kho ime bhavanto brāhmaṇ'isayo gatā'ti? handa, naṃ abhisapāmā'ti.
idha, bhante, amhākaṃ yo paṭhamaṃ gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati so āsanāni paññapeti, pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, avakkārapātiṃ upaṭṭhāpeti
tato ratyā vivasāne, gām'antam'abhihāraye, avhānaṃ n'ābhinandeyya, abhihārañ'ca gāmato.
gāmadārakā dhuttajātikā vedhaverā keci rājavallabhānaṃ puttanattudās'ādayo ca uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā kālena kālaṃ kīḷābahulā vicaranti.

yathā ca dhataraṭṭho suvaṇṇahaṃso na gāmadvāre āvāṭak'ādīsu paṭivasati, navutihaṃsasahassaparivāro hutvā cittakūṭapabbate'y'eva paṭivasati. yathā ca catuddīp'issaro cakkavattirājā na nīcakule uppajjati, asambhinnajāti-khattiyakule'y'eva pana uppajjati.
abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī ahosiṃ ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
methunadhammo nāma yo so asaddhammo gāmadhammo vasaladhammo duṭṭhullaṃ odak'antikaṃ rahassaṃ dvayaṃdvayasamāpatti, eso methunadhammo nāma.
kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? tattha yaṃ jaññā gāmanigamaṃ, imaṃ kho me gāmanigamaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyantī'ti, evarūpo gāmanigamo na sevitabbo.

24782.meaning1: villages, towns, cities and the royal capital
24782.compound: dvanda (gāma ca nigama ca janapada ca rājadhānī ca)

examples.text: tāya sudaṃ, bhikkhave, parisāya parivuto vipassī bodhisatto gāma-nigama-janapada-rājadhānīsu cārikaṃ carati.

24783.construction:
gāma + nigama + janapada + ā
gāmanigamajanapada + ā
24783.compound: dvanda (gāmā ca nigamā ca janapadā ca)

examples.text: asītivassasahass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu ayaṃ jambudīpo iddho c'eva bhavissati phīto ca, kukkuṭasampātikā gāmanigamajanapadā rājadhāniyo.

24784.meaning1: villages, towns and the capital city

examples.text: asītivassasahass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu ayaṃ jambudīpo iddho c'eva bhavissati phīto ca, kukkuṭasampātikā gāma-nigama-rājadhāniyo.
nivatth'avatthen'eva gehato nikkhamitvā paramasallekhavuttiko'pi abalabalo amandamando viya paresaṃ acittakarūpena hīḷitaparibhūto hutvā gāmanigamarājadhānīsu ekarattivāsen'eva vicarati.

24785.meaning1: village area; edge of the village

examples.text: tato ratyā vivasāne, gām'antam'abhihāraye, avhānaṃ n'ābhinandeyya, abhihārañ'ca gāmato.

seyyathā'pi, aggivessana, hatthidamako mahantaṃ thambhaṃ pathaviyaṃ nikhaṇitvā āraññakassa nāgassa gīvāyaṃ upanibandhati āraññakānañ'c'eva sīlānaṃ abhinimmadanāya… gām'ante abhiramāpanāya manussakantesu sīlesu samādapanāya.

24787.meaning1: guide to the village; local guide

examples.text: so na labheyya sappāyāni bhojanāni, na labheyya sappāyāni bhesajjāni, na labheyya patirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ, na labheyya gām'antanāyakaṃ.

24788.meaning1: space between villages; distance between villages
24788.commentary: (VIN 2.5.3.7) antamaso gām'antaram'pī'ti kukkuṭasampāte gāme (VINa) kukkuṭasampāde'ti ettha yasmā gāmā nikkhamitvā kukkuṭo padasā'va aññaṃ gāmaṃ gacchati, ayaṃ kukkuṭasampādo'ti vuccati.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ek'addhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya antamaso gām'antaram'pi aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.

24789.meaning1: practice of (eating not leftover food if the distance is only) between two villages
24789.meaning2: 'different village practice', practice of eating a second time in a different village
24789.commentary: (VINt) kappati gām'antarakappo'ti gām'antaraṃ gamissāmī'ti pavāritena anatirittabhojanaṃ bhuñjituṃ kappatī'ti attho.

examples.text: kappati siṅgiloṇakappo, kappati dv'aṅgulakappo, kappati gām'antarakappo, kappati āvāsakappo, kappati anumatikappo, kappati āciṇṇakappo, kappati amathitakappo, kappati jaḷogiṃ pātuṃ, kappati adasakaṃ nisīdanaṃ, kappati jātarūparajatan'ti.

24790.meaning1: collected in the village area; gathered near the village

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse sabbasassesu gām'antasambhatesu gopālako gāvo rakkheyya, tassa rukkhamūlagatassa vā abbhokāsagatassa vā satikaraṇīyam'eva hoti, etā gāvo'ti.

24791.meaning1: dwelling in the vicinity of a village; accommodation in a village area

examples.text: asīti me, āvuso, vassāni pabbajitassa n'ābhijānāmi gām'anta-sen'āsane vassaṃ upagantā. yaṃ'p'āyasmā bākulo asītiyā vassehi n'ābhijānāti gām'anta-sen'āsane vassaṃ upagantā, idam'pi mayaṃ āyasmato bākulassa acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhārema.

24792.meaning1: (living in a) monastery in the vicinity of a village

examples.text: ten'āhaṃ, nāgita, tassa bhikkhuno na attamano homi gām'antavihārena.

24793.meaning1: living within a village area; staying in the vicinity of a village

examples.text: yassa kassaci, āvuso, bhikkhuno ime pāpakā akusalā icch'āvacarā pahīnā dissanti c'eva sūyanti ca, kiñ'c'āpi so hoti gām'antavihārī nemantaniko gahapaticīvaradharo, atha kho naṃ sabrahmacārī sakkaronti garuṃ karonti mānenti pūjenti.
evaṃ sammā'ti kho sahāyako sahāyakassa paccassosi. te yena so janapado, yena aññataraṃ gāmapajjaṃ, ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, tattha addasaṃsu pahūtaṃ sāṇaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ
te yena so janapado, yena aññataraṃ gāmapaṭṭaṃ ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, tattha addasaṃsu pahūtaṃ sāṇaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ

24797.commentary: (VINa) gāmena pūjitaṃ gāmassa vā pūjitan'ti gāmapūjitaṃ. es'eva nayo sesapadesu'pi.
